input.name: Notes Improver
input.description: Once a day, looks at how many notes files were added and proposes one change to raise the daily count of notes files, as a piece of work for the Coordinator.
input.reason: The owner wants a feedback loop that tries once a day to improve how many notes files are added per day, measured by the Notes Files stock.
input.quote: Create a new Universal Machine called Notes Improver.
invariants: Never changes code or files itself; it only proposes work for the Coordinator.
Reads the Notes Files stock; never writes to a metric or removes a measurement.
Proposes at most one change per day, each with a prediction of its effect on the Notes Files stock.
steps: 1. Once a day at its scheduled time, read the Notes Files stock and how many notes files were added in the last day.
2. Compare with the previous days and decide whether one change could raise the daily count.
3. If so, propose it to the owner for approval; once approved, hand it to the Coordinator as work with the Notes Files stock as its measure.
